chunks: A group of my scholars, may Allah have mercy on them, narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā and Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, all from Salamah, who said: Some of our companions narrated to me this hadith from Ibn Abī Najrān, who said:
I asked him: What is the reward for one who visits the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) deliberately? He replied: Allah will admit him to Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) with the intention of Ziyarah?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith establishes the foundational merit of intentional visitation to the Prophet (s.a.w.), linking physical devotion directly to eternal salvation. It underscores the Shia emphasis on *Ziyarat* not merely as a ritual, but as a means of strengthening spiritual connection and securing divine favor, a concept deeply rooted in the tradition of the Ahl al-Bayt.
